name: MediaPipe selfie segmenter
license_evidence: The model card (Tingbo Hou, Siargey Pisarchyk, Karthik Raveendran; Google; 2021-05-06, 'MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation') states 'Licensed under Apache License, Version 2.0'. The MediaPipe repository is Apache-2.0.
input: float32 RGB in 0..1, 256x256 (NCHW here, NHWC in the TFLite original)
conversion_notes: Weights are copied unchanged (float16 widened to float32); layout NCHW; HARD_SWISH is HardSigmoid(1/6, 0.5) times its input; the MediaPipe custom Convolution2DTransposeBias is ConvTranspose. Output agrees with the original run in TensorFlow Lite (ai-edge-litert) to 4e-5 on structured inputs; the Rust test tract_agrees_with_the_tensorflow_lite_reference pins reference values.
